newsitem.title: CANADA: Canadian dollar ends quiet day down slightly.
newsitem.headline: Canadian dollar ends quiet day down slightly.

text.p: * Canada's dollar closed slightly weaker at C$1.3712 (US$0.7293) from Tuesday's close of C$1.3703 (US$0.7298) in quiet trading, dealers said.
* They said the currency stuck to a very narrow range as the firm U.S. dollar stole the limelight, drawing away the cross trading that has kept Canada's currency active recently.
Market players continue to keep an eye on the U.S. Federal Reserve, dealers said.
If the Fed raises U.S. rates and the Bank of Canada does not follow suit, the Canadian dollar could suffer, they said.
On the crosses, the Canada eased to 1.1017 marks from Tuesday's close of 1.1020 marks and rose to 80.44 yen from 80.12 yen.
